hero.title: 💞 Name Combiner
hero.tagline: Blend two names into one: ship names, couple names and baby name ideas.

article.intro: Fans have been blending names for years: Ron and Hermione become Romione, and the press turned Ben Affleck and Jennifer Lopez into Bennifer. This **name combiner** does the same with any two names you type, as a ship name for a couple or characters, a joint name for a wedding hashtag, or a starting point for a baby name made from both parents' names.

sections.heading: How a good ship name works
sections.content:
The best blends keep the start of one name and the end of the other, joined where the sounds flow: Ron + Hermione keeps "Ro" and "mione" for Romione. Joins that put a vowel next to a consonant read naturally; two vowels or three consonants in a row usually trip the tongue.

Every pair gives a different set of blends, and the order of the names matters: try them both ways round. The generator already does, but a blend that starts with the other name often feels like a different couple.

sections.heading: Uses for a combined name
sections.content:
• Ship names for fictional couples, in fan fiction, fan art and forums.
  • Couple names for wedding hashtags, joint social accounts or a shared house name.
  • Baby names: a blend of both parents' names can be a starting point. Check the result is a name you'd actually like to call across a playground.
  • Business or band names for two founders or two members.

sections.heading: Tips for better blends
sections.content:
• Try nicknames. Sam and Alex give different blends from Samuel and Alexandra.
  • Say it out loud. A blend that looks good can sound odd, and the other way round.
  • Check what it spells. Some blends turn into real words, occasionally unfortunate ones.

For a new name rather than a blend, try the Stage Name Generator, or the Band Name Generator for a duo.

faqs.question: How do you make a ship name?
faqs.answer: Take the start of one name and the end of the other, joined where the sounds flow: Ron + Hermione = Romione. Type two names into the combiner to see the options.

faqs.question: Can I combine two names for a baby name?
faqs.answer: Yes: type both parents' names and look for a blend you like, or use it as inspiration for a real name with a similar sound.

faqs.question: Does it work with any names?
faqs.answer: Yes, with any two names or words. It uses the first word of each box, and very short names are also simply joined end to end.
